Residents:
Ines (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: friends, music, houseplants. Note: Was home sick Friday/Saturday. Monday: Home sick, stayed in.
Yuki (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: meditation, movies, houseplants. Cares for the dog. Monday: Home all day.
Hana (40s, WFH): Weekdays at desk 9:00–17:30, sometimes out for lunch. Weekends sleeps in, midday errands, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, snacking. Monday: Home sick, stayed in.
